{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define conversion as status == 'completed'
df['converted'] = (df['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Now calculate conversion rate for each channel
total_by_channel = df.groupby('channel').size()
converted_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_by_channel = converted_by_channel / total_by_channel

# Extract rates for email and paid_search
cr_email = conversion_rate_by_channel['email']
cr_paid_search = conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']

# Compute difference (email - paid_search)
difference = cr_email - cr_paid_search

# Print results
difference, cr_email, cr_paid_search"}
